name: Medio Electronics
summary: A single-shop electronics store dressed as a big high-street electronics retailer: one deep violet for every action, magenta savings and rounded white cards on a light grey page; a header with a rotating message strip, Shop All, Services and Deals panels and a big round search; a deals-first home (campaign strip, hero deals, round category tiles, promo tiles, brand deals, dark deal cards with real clocks, tabbed rails, pastel promise tiles, buying guides); a category hub over every results page; results with a Filters card and a List / Grid toggle (a list row with a price column); a product page with a sticky buy card, add-ons, Buy together and accordions; a basket drawer, a desk account, Help & Support and a designed 404. English, Arabic (RTL), Hindi and Danish.
